LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hollin_Planted: For the Greening, {PLANTERS} of {HOME} set {SAPLINGS} saplings in the ground for the {FELLED} trees felled since the last one.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hollin_NoGround: For the Greening, {HOME} owed a sapling for each of the {FELLED} trees felled since the last one, but there was no open ground near the cleared land to set them in.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hollin_NoneFelled: No tree was felled at {HOME} since the last Greening, so no sapling was owed.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hollin_MealSome: Then {EATERS} of them sat down together {WHERE}, and {ATE} of them had {FOOD} to eat.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hollin_MealNoFood: Then {EATERS} of them sat together {WHERE}, with nothing in the stores to share.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hollin_Book: {SAPLINGS} saplings were set in the earth for the {FELLED} trees that fell, and the feast eaten beneath the eldest tree, as the Greening asketh.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hollin_BookNone: No tree fell since the last Greening, and so no sapling was owed; the feast was eaten beneath the eldest tree, as the Greening asketh.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Smoulder_Text: For the Deep Silver, {PAWN} carried {COUNT} silver from the stores at {HOME} and dropped it down {PLACE}, saying the mountain's names over it.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Smoulder_TextNone: For the Deep Silver, {PAWN} went down to {PLACE} at {HOME} with nothing to drop, there being no silver in the stores, and said the mountain's names there all the same.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Smoulder_Book: {COUNT} silver was cast down {PLACE} for the Deep Silver, and the mountain praised by every name it hath.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Smoulder_BookNone: No silver was there to cast down {PLACE} for the Deep Silver, and yet the mountain was praised by every name it hath.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Bellwether_Herd: For the Letting Pass, {HERDER} walked {COUNT} of the colony's animals out to the long grass at the edge of {HOME} and left them to graze it.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Bellwether_Alone: For the Letting Pass, {HERDER} walked out alone to the long grass at the edge of {HOME}, with no animals free to walk out with.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Bellwether_Story: At dusk {TELLER} told the old story there to {LISTENERS}.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Bellwether_StoryChildren: At dusk {TELLER} gathered the children there, {LISTENERS}, and told them the old story.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Bellwether_StoryNobody: At dusk {TELLER} went out to tell the old story there, and nobody came to hear it.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Bellwether_BookNoStory: For the Letting Pass {COUNT} beasts of the herd were walked out to the long grass and let graze it.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Bellwether_Book: For the Letting Pass {COUNT} beasts of the herd were walked out to the long grass and let graze it, and the old story was told by {TELLER} at dusk.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Morel_Dug: For the Turning Under, {PAWN} carried {COUNT} {SCRAPS} out to the field at {HOME} and dug them under, and {CELLS} squares of the field turned dark and rich.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Morel_DugNoRich: For the Turning Under, {PAWN} carried {COUNT} {SCRAPS} out to the field at {HOME} and dug them under.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Morel_Turned: For the Turning Under, {PAWN} turned the soil of the field at {HOME} with nothing from the stores to give back to it, and {CELLS} squares of it turned dark and rich.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Morel_TurnedNoRich: For the Turning Under, {PAWN} turned the soil of the field at {HOME} with nothing from the stores to give back to it.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Morel_Stew: {COOK} cooked {MEALS} meals of mushroom stew from the {FUNGUS} in the stores for the feast.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Morel_NoStew: No mushroom stew was cooked for the feast this year.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Morel_Book: The year's leavings were given back unto the earth for the Turning Under, and the field made rich thereby, and mushroom stew was eaten at the feast.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Morel_BookNoStew: The year's leavings were given back unto the earth for the Turning Under, and the field made rich thereby.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Pip_Mended: For the First Spark, {PAWN} mended the {BROKEN} at {HOME}.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Pip_NotMended: For the First Spark, {PAWN} set to mending the {BROKEN} at {HOME} but did not finish it.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Pip_NothingBroken: For the First Spark, {PAWN} looked for something broken at {HOME} to mend and found nothing.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Pip_Machines: {PAWN} walked round {COUNT} of the machines one by one and looked each over.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Pip_Benches: There being no machines, {PAWN} walked round {COUNT} of the work benches one by one and looked each over.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Pip_Lights: The lamps were lit at dusk and left burning through the night; {LIT} lights were burning at dawn, and the ones lit for the night were put out again.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Pip_Book: For the First Spark the {BROKEN} was mended, the machines looked over one by one, and every light left burning through the night.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Pip_BookNothing: For the First Spark the machines were looked over one by one, and every light left burning through the night.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hush_Text: For the Stillness, {COUNT} of {HOME} sat down to a silent supper of {FOOD} {WHERE}.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hush_TextSome: For the Stillness, {COUNT} of {HOME} sat down to a silent supper {WHERE}, and {ATE} of them had {FOOD} to eat.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hush_TextNoFood: For the Stillness, {COUNT} of {HOME} sat together in silence {WHERE}, with no plain meal in the stores to share.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hush_Nearest: {NAMES} had the places nearest the fire.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hush_NearestTable: {NAMES} had the first places at the table.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hush_Book: A supper was eaten in silence for the Stillness, of the plainest fare, and the old and the sick were set nearest the fire.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Hush_BookPlain: A supper was eaten in silence for the Stillness, of the plainest fare.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Undertow_Text: For the Shuttered Night, {PAWN} went round {HOME} as night fell shutting {DOORS} doors and lighting the lamps, and {LIT} lights were burning there by ten o'clock.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Undertow_TextNoDoors: For the Shuttered Night, {PAWN} went round {HOME} as night fell lighting the lamps, and {LIT} lights were burning there by ten o'clock.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Undertow_Torches: {PAWN} also set about topping up {COUNT} torches and braziers that were low on fuel.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Undertow_Book: On the Shuttered Night the doors were shut and every lamp lit, that it might pass us by; {LIT} lights burned through the dark.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Selene_WatchLabel: the watch on the longest night
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Selene_Text: For the Longest Night, {WATCHERS} kept watch on the walls of {HOME} until dawn, and at breakfast {DREAMS} of the colony told what they had dreamt.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Selene_TextNoDreams: For the Longest Night, {WATCHERS} kept watch on the walls of {HOME} until dawn; nobody told a dream at breakfast.
LanguageData.CC_Feast_Selene_Book: The longest night was watched through upon the walls by {WATCHERS} until the dawn, and {DREAMS} dreams were told at the morning's board.
